red_tests.failure_fingerprint: AssertionError: Agent token must be fine-grained PAT (github_pat_…), got prefix 'ghp_fake...'

correction_reason: Sequence-1 baseline (pre-rebase commit 250969d2, baseline_parent 5087d730) hard-failed TestAgentScopedTokenExists whenever GH_AGENT_TOKEN was unset. CI never sets GH_AGENT_TOKEN, so the canary would keep main permanently red (7 known-red tests instead of 5) — signal pollution that hides real regressions. This baseline converts the canary to skip-if-unconfigured: unset token SKIPS with an explicit owner-action reason; when the token IS set, validation is unchanged and full-strength (fine-grained github_pat_ format, classic ghp_/gho_/ghs_/ghu_ rejected, separation from owner token). Red evidence: GH_AGENT_TOKEN=ghp_fake… makes the format check fail hard, proving enforcement still works. supersedes = post-rebase baseline commit 75f2a57d (rebase onto origin/main changed SHAs; 5087d730 no longer resolvable as manifest baseline_parent).
rationale: KAN-98 agent permission segmentation, sequence 2. Converts the permanently-red token-existence canary to skip-if-unconfigured to prevent CI signal pollution on main while preserving full-strength enforcement when GH_AGENT_TOKEN is configured. All negative controls (branch protection, rulesets, secrets, deploy keys, collaborators, repo deletion, user SSH keys), positive controls, owner-token checks, and policy-document tests are unchanged. Red test proves enforcement: a classic PAT (ghp_…) set as GH_AGENT_TOKEN fails the fine-grained format assertion.
